summary: Tested new Bons Plans (deals) + monetization (Stripe) endpoints and UI for iteration 2. 20/20 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend flows verified: public /deals page, candidate /deals/new (pending banner), company-no-sub banner with goto-subscribe, /payments/subscribe with 2 plans, S'abonner click redirects to checkout.stripe.com, /admin/monetization dashboard. One real backend bug found: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns HTTP 500 (unhandled stripe._error.InvalidRequestError) when Stripe SDK retrieve fails — should catch and return cached transaction.

minor.issue: Raises HTTP 500 when Stripe retrieve fails (e.g. session not yet propagated or unknown). Should catch CheckoutError/InvalidRequestError and return the cached tx with payment_status='pending'. Repro: create checkout then immediately GET status — stripe returns 404 'No such checkout.session' and server crashes with unhandled exception.

issues: Date d'expiration uses browser-default date picker (input type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar component — minor consistency issue.

action_items: Wrap stripe_co.get_checkout_status(session_id) in try/except in GET /api/payments/status/{session_id}; on Stripe error return the cached tx dict (payment_status='pending') instead of HTTP 500.
(Optional) Replace native <input type='date'> on NewDealPage with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grown to 1325 lines — split into routers (auth, offers, deals, payments, admin, posts, social) is now strongly recommended.
payment_status endpoint trusts the Stripe SDK to always succeed; should be defensive (the same fragility could break the /payment/success page in production).
/api/payments/checkout creates a payment_transactions row before knowing the checkout session is usable — fine, but no cleanup job for stuck 'initiated' rows.
validate_deal uses untyped `body: dict` — switch to a Pydantic model (e.g. {action: Literal['approve','refuse','disable']}).
/api/deals/{id}/click and /share have no auth and no rate limit — trivially spammable to inflate stats.
company_subscription_active mutates DB inside a read path (auto-expire) — acceptable but consider a background job.
fulfill_transaction sets old active subs to 'renewed' then inserts a new one — multiple historic 'renewed' rows accumulate; cleaner to mark previous as 'replaced' or upsert.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (deals list, new deal flow candidate+company, subscribe page redirect, admin monetization)

seed_data_creation: Tests insert active subscription via pymongo for hr@technova.fr (cleaned up by fixture teardown). Created several TEST_ prefixed deals; cleaned via mongosh post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_deals_payments.py covers deals CRUD/save/click/share/views, admin pending+validate, checkout for sub_monthly/sub_yearly/boost_student/boost_company with correct 400/403 guards, subscription me/cancel, admin monetization. To simulate an active company subscription, the fixture inserts directly into db.subscriptions with status='active' and a 30d future end_date. Stripe session creation works (returns checkout.stripe.com URL) but GET /payments/status/{session_id} currently 500s for unpaid sessions — main agent must wrap stripe retrieve in try/except.
rca of the issue: Endpoint GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} (server.py:1238) calls stripe_co.get_checkout_status(session_id). emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout raises CheckoutError when stripe SDK throws InvalidRequestError ('No such checkout.session'). The error is not caught and bubbles up as HTTP 500. Fix: wrap in try/except CheckoutError; on failure, return the cached `tx` (payment_status='pending'). This unblocks the /payment/success polling path.
